input: Research local co-op grocery membership options

gold.taskTitle: Research Local Co-op Grocery Membership Options
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate co-op grocery membership options available in the user's local area.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood are you searching in?
questions.description: Identify the geographic area to focus the co-op research on.

questions.title: Have you already identified any specific co-ops nearby?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a starting list or is starting from scratch.

questions.title: What is your main reason for joining a co-op?
questions.description: Understand the primary motivation, such as cost savings, local sourcing, community, or organic produce.

questions.title: What is your budget for a membership fee?
questions.description: Clarify how much the user is willing to spend on joining, since fees vary widely.

questions.title: Are you open to co-ops requiring volunteer work hours?
questions.description: Some co-ops require members to contribute labor hours as part of membership.

questions.title: Do you need the co-op to offer online ordering or delivery?
questions.description: Determine whether in-store-only co-ops are acceptable or if digital access is required.

questions.title: When do you want to make a final membership decision?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or timeframe to help prioritize and pace the research.
